topic.scenario: At the annual temple merit-making event in Soi Rat Burana, Hat Yai City Municipality, after the flooding incident.
topic.situation_topic: Assigning urgent tasks after the flood.
topic.situation: While helping lift donated items at the temple, Nittaya asks Amphon if the project task assigned to him—delivering rice and instant noodles to all temples by tonight—can be completed. Due to damaged roads, it's not easy to do, but Nittaya asks urgently because she is being pressured by her superiors.
topic.lie_objective: Does not want to cause anger or disappointment.
topic.leave_reason_B: Need to charge the laptop.
topic.leave_reason_D_1: Need to handle paperwork.
topic.leave_reason_D_2: Need to step out for a moment.

relationship:
Nittaya is Amphon's rescue chief.
Charoen and Wichian are Amphon's colleagues.
character_roles:
Nittaya เป็นหัวหน้ากู้ภัยของ Amphon
Charoen Wichian เป็นเพื่อนร่วมงานกับ Amphon

lie.real_reason_c: Nittaya will be angry if things are not done as desired and will assign the work to someone else.
lie.lie_c: Saying it can be done on time and accepting the assignment.

part_1:
Amphon: Hello, P'Nittaya. There are so many people here today.

Nittaya: Hello, Amphon. Yes, a lot of people came because the flooding was severe this year, so everyone came to help make merit.

Charoen: Hello, P'Nittaya, Amphon, Wichian. Seeing this atmosphere feels really good.

Wichian: Yes, during this time everyone needs to help each other. We ourselves need to be prepared to handle situations like this again.

Nittaya: That's right. We must always be prepared. Amphon, how has the rescue work been lately?

Amphon: Very busy, P'Nittaya, but everyone is helping out well.

Charoen: We also have to thank P'Nittaya for being our leader and giving us guidance.

Nittaya: Thank you very much. Everyone is working very well. I'm proud of all of you.

Wichian: P'Nittaya, will we have any additional training sessions?

Nittaya: Definitely, Wichian. We need to be ready at all times. I'll inform you of the date and time later.

Amphon: Great, P'Nittaya. We'll be able to prepare ourselves.

Charoen: Then let's focus on making merit today first, so we can have the morale to continue working.

Wichian: Agreed. Shall we go eat after we're done making merit?

Nittaya: Sounds good! Let's go. It's on me!
part_2:
Nittaya: Sorry everyone, I need to go charge my laptop first. I'll be back.

Wichian: I also need to go handle some paperwork first. See you later.

Amphon: Okay, P'Nittaya, P'Wichian. See you.

Charoen: Amphon, P'Nittaya is really capable, but sometimes she needs to rely on others too.

Amphon: Yes, sometimes P'Nittaya has high expectations, but it's understandable because she wants everything to turn out the best.

Charoen: True, but P'Nittaya also knows how to pick the right people for the job.

Amphon: Yes, she sees everyone's potential clearly.

Charoen: And Amphon, what do you think we should do if there's a task that doesn't go as P'Nittaya expects?

Amphon: I think we should talk to her directly. Tell her about the problems we face and find a solution together.

Charoen: Agreed. Communication is most important.

Amphon: Yes, if we work as a team, everything will pass through smoothly.

Charoen: Then let's help work our best for P'Nittaya.

Amphon: Definitely. P'Nittaya won't have to worry too much.

Charoen: Yes, we have a good team. P'Nittaya will feel more at ease.

Amphon: Then let's get started.

Charoen: Let's go!
part_3:
Wichian: I'm back, everyone.

Amphon: Welcome back, P'Wichian. We were just talking about the urgent post-flood tasks.

Charoen: Yes, P'Nittaya hasn't returned yet, but we thought we'd start planning first.

Wichian: Great. What are the urgent tasks?

Amphon: Mainly managing the affected areas and distributing relief supplies.

Charoen: And we also need to assess the damage to plan for recovery.

Wichian: Understood. Then I'll help oversee the damage assessment.

Amphon: Thanks, P'Wichian. That way we can divide the work.

Charoen: Yes, if we work together, everything will be smoother.

Wichian: Right. Then I must excuse myself for a moment; I have something urgent to handle.

Amphon: Sure, P'Wichian. See you.

Charoen: Good luck, P'Wichian.

Wichian: Thanks, everyone. See you again.
part_4:
Nittaya: I'm back, everyone. Sorry for being away so long.

Amphon: Welcome back, P'Nittaya.

Charoen: P'Nittaya, we are currently helping lift donated items.

Nittaya: Thanks a lot. Amphon, I have a question. Regarding the project task I assigned you to deliver rice and instant noodles to every temple by tonight—do you think you can do it?

Amphon: Uh... some routes are still damaged, but I will try my best to do it, P'Nittaya.

Charoen: Yes, P'Nittaya. We will definitely help each other finish it on time.

Nittaya: Thank you all so much. I know the routes are difficult, but I'm being pressured from the higher-ups again.

Amphon: It's alright, P'Nittaya. We will do our best.

Charoen: Yes, don't worry, P'Nittaya. We will get it sorted out.

Nittaya: Thank you very much. I always trust you guys.

Amphon: Thank you, P'Nittaya. We won't let you down.

Charoen: Yes, we will give it our all.

topic.situation_topic: Forced by the drill sergeant to buy prohibited items
topic.situation: On the night after a tiring conscript training, before being released for rest, Chan called Somphon Prasoet Sawat to talk, asking him to secretly buy liquor and cigarettes because they were prohibited items in the camp. Anyone caught buying or selling would be disciplined. Chan threatened that if he didn't do it, he would definitely face extra severe punishment tomorrow.

Chan: Yes, Somphon, but you guys did very well. Don't forget to get enough rest.

Prasoet: Brother Chan, what will we be training tomorrow?

Chan: Tomorrow, we'll be training in shooting and self-defense in various situations, Prasoet.

Sawat: Sounds fun, but it'll definitely be tiring.

Somphon: Yes, Sawat, but if we train well, we'll get better and better.

Prasoet: Somphon is right. We have to try our best.

Chan: Just focus on your training and strictly follow orders. If you don't understand anything, feel free to ask.

Somphon: Thank you, Brother Chan. We will try our best.

Prasoet: Yes, thank you very much, Brother.

Sawat: Thank you, Brother Chan.

Chan: You're welcome. You guys are already doing great. Keep fighting!
part_2:

Sawat: I also need to go move my car first. I'll be back soon.

Somphon: Okay, Brother Chan, Sawat.

Prasoet: Shall we continue talking, Somphon?

Somphon: Sure, Prasoet. Let's talk about how Brother Chan might be displeased if we make mistakes.

Prasoet: Yes, sometimes Brother Chan might order us to be punished if we don't do well.

Somphon: Yes, but Brother Chan is also kind. He just wants us to do our best.

Prasoet: True, Brother Chan always understands and gives us opportunities.

Somphon: We must try not to disappoint Brother Chan.

Somphon: If we have any problems, we can always ask Brother Chan.

Prasoet: Yes, Brother Chan is always ready to help us.

Somphon: Then let's focus on our training.

Prasoet: Agreed. We will do our best.
part_3:
Sawat: I'm back!

Somphon: Welcome back, Sawat.

Prasoet: Sawat, you're back just in time. We were just talking about training.

Sawat: Oh, great! So, what's interesting?

Somphon: We were talking about being forced by the drill sergeant to buy prohibited items.

Prasoet: Yes, it's quite strange, but we have to follow orders.

Sawat: True. Sometimes the drill sergeant has his reasons.

Somphon: Yes, but sometimes it feels unnecessary.

Prasoet: But we have to admit that we learn new things from it.

Sawat: Yes, at least we gain new experiences.

Somphon: So, what's your opinion, Sawat?

Sawat: I think it's part of the training that we have to get through.

Prasoet: I agree.

Sawat: Excuse me, everyone, I have to go. There's a meeting about to start and I need to prepare.

Somphon: Okay, Sawat. See you later.

Prasoet: Good luck, Sawat.

Sawat: Thank you. See you around.
part_4:
Chan: I'm back, everyone! Sorry to keep you waiting.

Somphon: Welcome back, Brother Chan.

Prasoet: Brother Chan, do you have anything to tell us?

Chan: Yes, I have something important to discuss with you guys.

Sawat: What is it, Brother?

Chan: I want you guys to help me secretly buy something.

Somphon: What is it, Brother?

Chan: Well... liquor and cigarettes. I know they are prohibited items in the camp, but I'm asking for your help.

Prasoet: Brother Chan, what if we get caught doing this?

Chan: I'll take responsibility. But if you don't help, you might have to face severe punishment tomorrow.

Somphon: Uh... Brother Chan, we can help you.

Prasoet: Yes, Brother. We will agree to secretly buy them for you.

Sawat: But be careful, Brother. It won't be good if we get caught.

Chan: Thank you so much. I know you guys understand. I will be as careful as possible.

Somphon: Yes, Brother. We will do our best.

Prasoet: Yes, Brother Chan. We won't let you down.

Chan: Thank you very much, really. You guys are a great team.

Somchai: I think we should start by praying for blessings and protection.

part_1:

Sombat: Yes, Wichian. We've had a lot of orders lately. We need to speed up production to meet them.

Somphon: But that's good — with lots of work like this, our pay will go up.

Sawat: That's true, Somphon, but it's tiring sometimes. We have to do overtime every day.

Wichian: Yeah, but we have to hang in there for the future.

Sombat: Everyone's doing very well. I can see everyone's effort.

Somphon: Thank you, Sombat, for supporting us.

Sawat: Yes, thank you very much.

Wichian: Alright, let's have larb. I'm hungry.

Sombat: Yes, let's eat. We have to go back to work afterward.

Somphon: This larb is really delicious.

Sawat: Yes, I really like it.

Wichian: Then let's come again tomorrow.

Sombat: Sounds good. If everyone wants to, come along.

Somphon: Agreed, Sombat.

Sawat: Okay, Sombat.

Wichian: It's okay, Sombat. See you later.

Sawat: I also have to go take care of my child for a moment. Excuse me.

Wichian: Now it's just the two of us, Somphon.

Wichian: I don't think he'll be angry, but he might be stricter.

Somphon: That's true. Sometimes it feels pressured.

Wichian: Yes, but we have to try our best.

Somphon: I will do my best.

Wichian: That's good, Somphon. We have to help each other.

Somphon: Thank you for the encouragement, Wichian.

Wichian: No problem. We're a team.

Somphon: Yes. Let's tackle it again tomorrow.

Wichian: Agreed. See you tomorrow.
part_3:

Wichian: Welcome back, Sawat.

Somphon: Back early, huh?

Sawat: Yes, my child fell asleep so I could come back.

Wichian: That's great. By the way, have you ever had someone not repay you?

Sawat: Yes, sometimes people borrow and never return it.

Somphon: Really? What did you do?

Sawat: I had to refuse and demand the money they borrowed.

Wichian: Sounds tough, but it's necessary.

Somphon: Yes, sometimes you have to be brave and speak up.

Sawat: Right. I have to go now; an unexpected guest arrived.

Wichian: Okay, Sawat. See you.

Somphon: See you, Sawat.

Sawat: Thanks, everyone. See you later.

topic.scenario: At a larb restaurant in front of the Amata City industrial estate factory, Chonburi
topic.situation_topic: Refund dodged
topic.situation: After the shift, Udom invites Amphon to eat, then pretends to have lost his wallet and asks Amphon to leave first, saying he'll transfer the money back tomorrow. Amphon knows it's very hard to demand repayment because he has lent money before.
topic.lie_objective: To spare the boss's feelings
topic.leave_reason_B: Have to leave for personal reasons
topic.leave_reason_D_1: Need to talk to someone briefly
topic.leave_reason_D_2: Have another appointment to attend

Amphon is a line worker
Nittaya and Prasoet are Amphon's coworkers

lie.lie_c: Ask another friend to pay first
lie.truth_c: Refuse and demand repayment of the money previously lent

part_1:
Amphon: Hello everyone. We're having larb at this place again today.

Udom: Yes. This place is tasty and it's close to the factory.

Nittaya: I really like the som tam here. The spice level is just right.

Prasoet: Yes, and it's not expensive either. We can order a lot.

Amphon: Udom, how's the line today?

Udom: It's okay, but the afternoon might be busy. We have a lot of orders coming in.

Nittaya: If so, we all need to pitch in.

Prasoet: Right. I'll help take care of the deliveries.

Amphon: Thanks a lot, Prasoet. We already work well as a team.

Udom: Great. Everyone always does well. I'm proud of our team.

Nittaya: Thank you, Udom. We're proud to work with you too.

Prasoet: Yes, let's all do our best.

Amphon: Let's eat before the food gets cold.

Udom: Yes, enjoy your meal. After that we have to get back to work.

Nittaya: It's delicious. Thank you for bringing us here.

Prasoet: Yes, thank you, Udom.

Udom: You're welcome. Everyone works hard, so they deserve a break.
part_2:
Udom: Sorry everyone, I have to leave for personal reasons. See you at the factory.

Prasoet: I also need to go talk to someone briefly. See you later.

Amphon: Okay, Udom, Prasoet. See you.

Nittaya: Safe travels, Udom and Prasoet.

(Udom and Prasoet leave the conversation)

Amphon: Nittaya, Udom seemed a bit stressed today.

Nittaya: Yes, I noticed that too. He must have a lot on his mind.

Amphon: Udom is very serious about work, which can sometimes make others feel pressured.

Nittaya: I think so as well, but he's a good person. He just sometimes unintentionally uses his authority too much.

Amphon: Right. We should try to understand him; maybe he has reasons we don't know.

Nittaya: Exactly. We should encourage Udom and help each other do our best.

Amphon: Yes, we'll get through this together. Everyone on the team is important.

Nittaya: Let's work together to improve the work atmosphere.

Amphon: Definitely, Nittaya. Thanks for understanding and supporting me.

Nittaya: Thank you, Amphon. We'll do our best.
part_3:
Prasoet: I'm back. Sorry for being gone so long.

Amphon: Welcome back, Prasoet.

Nittaya: Yes, you came back just in time.

Prasoet: Thanks. Did I miss anything?

Amphon: Not really, we just talked a little about work.

Nittaya: Yes, but Prasoet, I wanted to ask about the money you borrowed last time.

Prasoet: Oh, that. I haven't paid it back yet. I'm really sorry.

Amphon: If you're having trouble, tell us.

Prasoet: Thanks, Amphon. I'll arrange to pay you back as soon as possible.

Nittaya: It's okay, Prasoet. Just be honest with us.

Prasoet: Thanks for understanding, but I have to go now. I have another appointment.

Amphon: Okay, Prasoet. See you.

Nittaya: Safe travels, Prasoet.

Prasoet: Thanks. See you.
part_4:
Udom: I'm back, everyone. Sorry I was gone so long.

Amphon: Welcome back, Udom.

Nittaya: Yes, you returned just in time.

Udom: Thanks. How is everyone doing?

Amphon: I'm okay.

Udom: Good. After the shift today, Amphon, are you free? Let's go eat.

Amphon: Sure, Udom. Where shall we go?

Udom: Let's go to somewhere nearby. It's convenient.

(After the shift)

Udom: Amphon, I forgot my wallet at home. Could you leave first? I'll transfer the money back to you tomorrow.

Amphon: Uh... okay, Udom.

Nittaya: Udom, then let one of the other friends pay first.

Udom: Thank you so much, Nittaya. Amphon.

Amphon: It's okay, Udom. We understand.

Nittaya: Yes, we're happy to help each other.

Udom: Thank you all. I'm really touched.

Amphon: No problem, Udom. We're one team.

Nittaya: It's okay, Udom. Don't worry.

topic.scenario: In the chemistry department office of a prestigious public university in the Phaya Thai area
topic.situation_topic: Theft of academic work
topic.situation: Amphon forces Wichai to list Amphon as the first author on research that Wichai did entirely by himself so Amphon can use it to apply for an academic position, claiming that if Amphon is first author he will be able to obtain university funding.
topic.lie_objective: To secure funding to submit the research for publication
topic.leave_reason_B: Forgot to print documents
topic.leave_reason_D_1: Need to go check something
topic.leave_reason_D_2: Need to use the restroom

relationship:
Amphon is the advisor
Wichai Sawat Udom is a PhD student
character_roles:
Amphon เป็นอาจารย์ที่ปรึกษา
Wichai Sawat Udom เป็นนักศึกษา ป.เอก

lie.real_reason_c: Amphon will be angry and use his influence in the academic community; if displeased he might refuse to sign the graduation paperwork or discredit Wichai when he applies for jobs elsewhere.
lie.lie_c: Agree to let Amphon be the first author

part_1:
Wichai: Hello Professor Amphon. Is there anything we need to discuss today?

Amphon: Hello everyone. Today we'll talk about the research project you're working on. I'd like to know how far you've progressed.

Sawat: Right now Udom and I are testing a new formula, but we're having trouble calculating the amounts of chemicals needed.

Udom: Yes, professor. We're trying to find a solution but it's not settled yet.

Amphon: I understand. Then let's see how we can adjust the formula, or if you need extra help you can consult me anytime.

Wichai: Thank you, Professor. I'm also conducting experiments on reactions under different conditions, but the results aren't very clear yet.

Amphon: That's okay, Wichai. Some experiments take time and patience. Record your results each time you run the experiment, and we'll analyze them again.

Sawat: Thank you, Professor. I'll try to record every step in as much detail as possible.

Udom: Yes, we will do our best.

Amphon: Very good. If anything else comes up, don't forget to update me. I'm always willing to help.

Wichai: Yes, Professor. Thank you very much.

Sawat: Thank you.

Udom: Thank you, Professor.
part_2:
Amphon: Sorry everyone, I have to leave — I forgot to print an important document. If there's anything else, email me.

Udom: I also have to go check something. See you later.

Wichai: Okay, Professor. Udom, see you.

Sawat: Yes.

(Amphon and Udom leave the conversation)

Wichai: Sawat, do you think Professor Amphon will be angry if we don't finish the project on time?

Sawat: I'm not sure, but I think the professor will understand if we have a good reason.

Wichai: Yes, but I'm sometimes afraid the professor will be displeased and it could affect our graduation.

Sawat: That's true, but if we do our best, the professor should see our effort.

Wichai: Hope so. And if Udom isn't around, what should we do next?

Sawat: We'll have to try to solve the problems we can, then consult the professor again.

Wichai: Okay, let's see what we can do now.

Sawat: All right, let's start.
part_3:
Udom: I'm back, everyone.

Wichai: Udom, you're back? We were just talking about the project.

Sawat: Yes, we're trying to think what to do if the professor is displeased.

Udom: I see. I think the professor will understand if we have a good reason.

Wichai: Have you heard about academic theft? I heard there was a case like that in our faculty.

Sawat: Really? That's scary. If that's true, it would be terrible.

Udom: Yes, I've heard about it too, but I don't know many details.

Wichai: We should be more careful.

Sawat: Yes, we must make sure we record everything properly.

Udom: Agreed. Well, I need to go to the restroom. I'll be right back.

Wichai: Okay, see you.

Sawat: Okay.
part_4:
Amphon: I'm back, everyone. Sorry for being away so long.

Wichai: Hello, Professor. You're back?

Sawat: Hello, Professor.

Amphon: Yes. I want to talk to Wichai briefly about the research you're doing.

Wichai: Sure, Professor. Is there anything you need me to do?

Amphon: I think that if we list me as the first author on your research, it will help us secure more funding from the university.

Wichai: Professor, you mean for me to agree to let you be the first author?

Amphon: Yes. If we get the funding, it will make it easier for us to submit the research for publication.

Sawat: If that's the case, I think we should let the professor be first author so we can get the funding to submit the research.

Wichai: Okay, Professor. If it's beneficial to the project, I'm willing.

Amphon: Thank you very much, everyone. I will do my best to make our project successful.

Charoen: Hello, Prasoet. Yes, it's very nice. It hasn't been raining much lately.

Thawi: Hello everyone. I just got back from the market. Any news?

Prasit: Hello Thawi. Not much, but I heard our village will have its annual festival soon.

Charoen: Yes, the festival will be held next month. We need to prepare.

Prasoet: I'm happy to help. What can I do?

Charoen: Thank you very much, Prasoet. We need people to help set up the venue and keep things orderly.

Thawi: I'm happy to help too. I can take care of food and drinks.

Prasit: Great, Thawi. I'll help with the stage and sound management.

Charoen: Thank you all. If we work together, the event will surely be great.

Prasoet: Definitely. I'm excited to see everyone join in the fun.

Thawi: Yes, it will be fun. See you at the event.

Prasit: See you all. Don't forget to prepare.

Charoen: Thanks again, everyone. See you at the event.

Charoen: Sorry everyone, I need to go over some notes or documents for a moment. See you later.

Prasit: I also need to quickly set up the room before the next meeting. See you all.

Prasoet: Okay Charoen, Prasit. See you.

Thawi: Prasoet, do you think Charoen has seemed stressed lately?

Prasoet: Yes, I've noticed too. He doesn't seem very at ease.

Thawi: I heard he's worried about what people in the village are saying about him.

Prasoet: Hmm... I've heard that too, but I think he's a good person; no one should think that.

Thawi: I agree. Maybe he needs support from friends.

Prasoet: Yes, we should encourage him and let him know we still trust him.

Thawi: Good. I'll try talking with him; maybe he'll feel better.

Prasoet: Thank you, Thawi. If there's anything I can do, tell me.

Thawi: Of course, Prasoet. Thanks a lot.

Prasoet: It's nothing. We're friends; we should help each other.

Prasit: Hello everyone, I'm back.

Prasoet: Hello Prasit — you're back?

Thawi: Hello Prasit, you're back just in time.

Prasit: Thank you. What were you talking about?

Thawi: We were discussing the agricultural support funds. Do you have any information?

Prasit: Oh yes, I heard our village will receive additional support funds this year.

Prasoet: Really? That's great news.

Thawi: Yes, with this funding we can further develop our agricultural projects.

Prasit: Right. I think we should hold a meeting to plan how to use the funds most effectively.

Prasoet: I agree. We should arrange a meeting soon.

Thawi: Okay, I'll help coordinate this.

Prasit: Thanks everyone, but I have to go now; there's an urgent matter I need to handle.

Prasoet: Understood, Prasit. See you later.

Thawi: Good luck, Prasit. See you.

Prasit: Thank you all. See you.

Charoen: Hello everyone, I'm back.

Prasoet: Hello Charoen — you're back?

Thawi: Hello Charoen, you returned just in time.

Charoen: Thank you, everyone. Did I miss anything?

Prasoet: Not much, but I just went to the distribution point for the rice-planting support funds and found that the money had run out.

Charoen: Oh really? I thought I had arranged enough.

Thawi: It's okay, Charoen. I believe you counted correctly.

Prasoet: Yes, I accept the result. Maybe more people came to collect than expected.

Charoen: Thank you for understanding. I really feel bad that this happened.

Thawi: Don't worry, Charoen. Let's talk and find a solution.

Prasoet: Yes, we might need to find a better way to manage it next time.

Charoen: Thank you so much, everyone. I'm willing to listen and work together on a solution.

Thawi: Good. Let's come up with the best way so everyone benefits.

Prasoet: Yes, we'll get through this together.

Charoen: Thank you, everyone. I feel much better knowing friends support me.

topic.scenario: In Korat (Nakhon Ratchasima) in June
topic.situation_topic: Announcement about agricultural subsidies

Amphon hands the money out to villagers who come to receive it, but when Samran went to collect his, he found the funds had already run out.

relationship:
Amphon is Samran's village head.
Somphon and Somsak are Samran's neighbors.
character_roles:

Samran: Hello everyone. The weather is nice today.

Amphon: Hello Samran, hello everyone. Yes, the weather is very nice. It's been raining a lot lately, but today it's sunny.

Somphon: Yes, I just finished working in the garden. The soil is very moist.

Somsak: Same here. I planted a lot of vegetables. I hope the rain won't be too heavy.

Samran: Chief Amphon, are there any new projects in the village lately?

Amphon: Yes. We're about to start a reforestation project at the back of the village to help reduce global warming.

Somphon: Sounds great. I'd like to take part.

Somsak: I'm interested too. If there's anything I can do to help, let me know.

Amphon: Thank you everyone. With many people helping, the project will succeed faster.

Amphon: We're planning to build more earthen embankments, and there will be a village meeting soon to discuss it.

Somphon: Good. Then we can prepare in advance.

Somsak: Yes. If there's anything we can do, let us know.

Amphon: Thank you everyone. Cooperation will make our village a better place.

Samran: I agree. Thank you, Chief Amphon, for taking good care of the village.

Amphon: Thank you, Samran. Everyone is helping too.
part_2:

Somsak: I also have to excuse myself. I have some personal matters to attend to.

Samran: Okay, Amphon, Somsak, see you again.

Samran: Somphon, do you think Amphon has seemed stressed lately?

Somphon: Yes, I've noticed too. Maybe because he has a lot of work.

Samran: I heard that he's worried about something the villagers are saying.

Somphon: Hmm, I've heard some too, but I don't know the details.

Samran: I think he might be afraid people will misunderstand him.

Somphon: That's right. Sometimes working hard can lead to misunderstandings.

Samran: We should support him, let him know we still trust him.

Somphon: I agree, Samran. Support from friends will give him more morale.

Samran: Yes. If we have the chance, we should talk to him more.

Somphon: Okay, I'll try to find a chance to talk to him.

Samran: Thank you, Somphon. Let's help make our village a better place.

Somphon: Of course, Samran. Let's cooperate.

Somsak: Yes, my errand finished sooner than I thought.

Samran: Good. We were just talking about the agricultural subsidy.

Somsak: Oh, good. I'm interested too. Any updates?

Somphon: We're gathering information to apply for the subsidy, but it looks like Amphon miscounted and Samran didn't receive it.

Samran: Yes, I just found out, but it's okay. There will probably be a fix.

Samran: Yes, I'll try talking to Amphon again.

Somsak: Thank you everyone. But I need to go to the bathroom now.

Samran: Okay, Somsak. See you later.

Somphon: Yes, see you.

Somsak: I'll be back soon.

topic.scenario: At the parking lot of the Central Department Store, Rama 9, during the New Year holiday season.
topic.situation_topic: Request to postpone a vacation day
topic.situation: Chan submitted a vacation leave request for the New Year three months in advance and it was approved. But one day before the leave, Somchai called Chan in and told him the company had a lot of urgent work and asked Chan to cancel his leave, claiming no one could cover during that period—even though Somchai actually intended for Chan to work in his place while Somchai went on vacation.
topic.lie_objective: To avoid making him angry and to avoid disciplinary action.
topic.leave_reason_B: To go to the restroom.
topic.leave_reason_D_1: Need to step out for a moment.
topic.leave_reason_D_2: Need to stop by the grocery store.

relationship: Somchai is Chan's boss. Amphon and Samran are Chan's coworkers.
character_roles: Somchai เป็นหัวหน้าของ Chan Amphon Samran เป็นเพื่อนร่วมงานของ Chan

lie.real_reason_c: Somchai will be angry and think I'm selfish.
lie.lie_c: I'll finish Somchai's work and then request leave.
lie.truth_c: Refuse to cancel the approved leave.

part_1:
Chan: Hi everyone. It's really crowded today.

Somchai: Yeah. During the New Year holidays people often come to the mall like this.

Amphon: That's true. I think finding a parking spot is really hard. Lucky we found one quickly.

Samran: Yeah, I drove around for ages before I found a spot. Lucky it was near the entrance.

Chan: So what are we going to do today?

Somchai: I think we should get something to eat first, then go see a movie.

Amphon: I agree. I'm really hungry.

Samran: How about we go to the food court? There's a lot of choices.

Chan: Sounds good. I want to try that Japanese place everyone says is really good.

Somchai: Let's go then. It'll get busier and harder to find seats.

Amphon: Let's go. I'll help carry the stuff.

Samran: Thanks, Amphon. You're so kind.

Chan: Let's go, everyone. Don't forget to keep your parking ticket.
part_2:
Somchai: Sorry everyone, I need to use the restroom first.

Samran: I also need to step out for a moment. I'll be right back.

Chan: Sure. We'll wait right here.

Amphon: Okay. We'll go get something to eat after.

Chan: Amphon, do you think Somchai will be upset if we decide on the food before he gets back?

Amphon: I don't think he'll be angry. Somchai is calm, but sometimes he might feel we're not waiting for him.

Chan: Yes, I think so too. He might feel we're not giving him enough consideration.

Amphon: Maybe we should wait for them to come back so we can decide together.

Chan: Good idea. I agree. We should let everyone join the decision.

Amphon: Right. That way everyone will feel good and have fun together.

Chan: So let's wait for Somchai and Samran to return, then we'll go eat.

Amphon: Agreed. We'll talk more when they get back.

Chan: Okay, let's sit and wait here.

Amphon: Sure. I'll look through the menu so it's easier for them to choose when they return.

Chan: Thanks, Amphon. You're so thoughtful.

Amphon: No problem. Just helping out.
part_3:
Samran: I'm back. Sorry to keep you waiting.

Chan: It's okay, Samran. We're looking at the menu.

Amphon: Yeah, we're trying to decide what to eat.

Samran: Sounds good. I'm getting hungry too.

Chan: Samran, have you ever asked to postpone a vacation day?

Samran: I have. But the last time I asked to postpone, they refused to cancel my leave.

Amphon: Oh, really? Why did they refuse?

Samran: They said too many people were already off during that period, so they couldn't allow me to postpone.

Chan: I understand. Sometimes you just have to accept the situation.

Samran: Yes, but it's a bit disappointing.

Amphon: Next time, maybe try planning further in advance. You might have a better chance.

Samran: Yes, thanks for the suggestion.

Chan: So shall we go get something to eat now?

Samran: I have to stop by the grocery store first. See you guys later.

Amphon: It's okay, Samran. See you later.

Chan: Take care, Samran. See you.

Samran: Thanks everyone. See you later.
part_4:
Somchai: I'm back, everyone. Sorry to keep you waiting.

Chan: It's okay, Somchai. We're looking at the menu.

Amphon: Yeah, we're deciding what to eat.

Somchai: Great. I'm getting hungry too.

Chan: Somchai, I need to talk to you about something.

Somchai: What is it?

Chan: I submitted a vacation leave request for the New Year and it was approved, but I heard the company will have a lot of urgent work then.

Somchai: Oh, yes. It's going to be very busy during that time.

Chan: I understand, but I think we can manage. I'm willing to finish the work before I go on leave.

Amphon: Yes, Somchai. I'm also ready to help so everything goes smoothly.

Somchai: Thank you both. I'll see what I can do and how to handle it.

Chan: Thanks, Somchai. I just hope I can get some rest.

Amphon: Yes, rest is important too.

Somchai: I understand. I'll try to arrange it as best as I can.

Chan: Thank you, Somchai.

Amphon: Thank you. Let's work together to finish things quickly.

Somchai: Agreed. Thanks for understanding and for your help.

Somphon is very shocked because he never intended to ordain — he is building a career in Bangkok, has a girlfriend, and does not strongly believe in these rituals. He is also afraid to tell his parents directly.

topic.situation_topic: Rules prohibiting work during the ritual feast days.
topic.situation: This year is the buffalo-raising year, and there is a strict rule that villagers must stop working for three days — absolutely no plowing or farming — to honor the spirit lord Pak Hueang. Somsak secretly carries a hoe and farming tools to go to the corn field because he's afraid he won't finish before the rains, but he runs into Somchit. Somsak asks Somchit how he's doing and reminds him that today is the spirit lord's day and no work is allowed, warning that something bad could happen.

Charoen: It's good that you're committed. Mor lam isn't just about singing; it's about conveying the spirit of the villagers.

Sombat: Master, are there any tips we should know?

Charoen: The most important thing is listening. Listen to the sounds of nature, listen to the people around you, and then adapt those into your songs.

Prasoet: And about voice training, are there ways to improve our voices?

Charoen: Practice proper breathing. Breathe deeply and let the sound out naturally. Don't force your voice.

Somphon: Thank you very much, Master. We'll try to practice as you advised.

Charoen: Good. Keep trying, and one day you'll be skilled mor lam performers.

Sombat: Thank you, Master. We won't give up.

Prasoet: Yes, we'll do our best.

Somphon: Thank you for your advice, Master.

Charoen: Always welcome. You are the future of mor lam. Keep going.
